issues.legal_issue: A Presidential notification under Article 342 is a prerequisite to conferring Scheduled Tribe benefits in a State or Union Territory.
A person recognised as a Scheduled Tribe in one State cannot claim Scheduled Tribe benefits in a Union Territory where no Presidential notification applies to that community.
An administrative clarification or reservation brochure cannot create Scheduled Tribe reservation contrary to Article 342.
An erroneous advertisement inviting Scheduled Tribe applications does not confer an entitlement to allotment or create estoppel against the housing authority.
